title: Alina Habba Mildon Faces Discipline Over Settlement at Trump Golf Club
summary: The state’s Office of Attorney Ethics recommended discipline for her role in brokering a sexual harassment settlement involving a waitress at the president’s golf club in Bedminster, N.J.
